nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config extending next/core-web-vitals and next/typescript via FlatCompat, ignoring the NestJS api/ folder and build output, and disabling no-explicit-any for legacy code.

nodes.name: .terraform.lock.hcl
nodes.summary: Terraform dependency lock file pinning the hashicorp/aws and hashicorp/random provider versions and checksums for the production infrastructure.

nodes.name: backend.hcl.example
nodes.summary: Example Terraform S3 backend config (state bucket, key, eu-north-1 region, encryption, lockfile) to copy into a git-ignored backend.hcl before terraform init.

nodes.name: terraform.tfvars.example
nodes.summary: Example Terraform variables for production: AWS region, budget alert email, API site domain and admin/deploy SSH public keys.

nodes.name: instrumentation.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js instrumentation hook that loads the Sentry server or edge config depending on runtime and reports request errors via Sentry.captureRequestError.

nodes.name: admin-translations-erp.ts
nodes.summary: Large table of [English, French, Arabic] translation rows for the ERP admin screens (orders pipeline, CRM, till, purchasing, finance, accounting, owner overview), merged into the main admin translations.

nodes.name: admin-translations.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the French and Arabic admin dictionaries keyed by English UI text, combining the core admin entries with the ERP entries (core rows win on duplicates).

nodes.name: report-error.ts
nodes.summary: Helper that sends caught, handled errors to Sentry tagged with the app area, for code paths that turn errors into responses or fallbacks.

nodes.name: Settings.json
nodes.summary: Placeholder next-intl English message file for a Settings namespace with a title and lorem-ipsum description; next-intl is largely unused.

nodes.name: next.config.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js configuration: rewrites /api/* to the NestJS API (NEST_URL), exposes ENV as NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENV, sets client router staleTimes, ignores build-time type/lint errors, whitelists remote image hosts including FILES_PUBLIC_URL, and wraps the config with Sentry.

nodes.name: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.summary: PostCSS config enabling the Tailwind CSS v4 plugin (@tailwindcss/postcss).

nodes.name: admin-sw.js
nodes.summary: Back-office service worker that shows Web Push notifications (RTL for Arabic, sticky for alerts and orders) and opens or focuses the related admin page when clicked.

nodes.name: move-database.mjs
nodes.summary: Copies the public, private and migration-history schemas from a source Postgres to a target Postgres 17 via a dockerized pg_dump/psql, then compares row counts per table; used for the Supabase move and backups/restores.

nodes.name: colissimo-mock.mjs
nodes.summary: In-memory HTTP stand-in for the Colissimo carrier APIs (v1 parcel creation and v2 track/validate/price change/edit/delete) with their rules and error codes, plus /__mock control endpoints for tests in local Docker and CI.

nodes.name: create-admin.mjs
nodes.summary: Creates or resets the local owner account admin@kachabity.local in the Docker Postgres with a bcrypt hash of LOCAL_PASSWORD from .env.docker.

nodes.name: env.mjs
nodes.summary: Generates .env.docker for the local Docker stack with random AUTH_SECRET and REVALIDATE_SECRET plus local database, API and S3 storage settings, keeping an existing file.

nodes.name: import-database.mjs
nodes.summary: Imports a read-only copy of a source database into the local Docker db via move-database.mjs, applies newer migrations, neutralizes passwords, sessions and e-mailed links, then recreates the local owner.

nodes.name: meta-webhook-test.mjs
nodes.summary: Sends HMAC-signed Meta-style webhook events (verification challenge, Facebook/Instagram comments, Messenger message) to the local API to exercise the CRM comment and inbox flow.

nodes.name: find-unused-code.sh
nodes.summary: Legacy shell report that lists potentially unused exports (ts-prune), unused packages (depcheck), large files, duplicated locale patterns, console statements and commented JSX.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Dynamically imports the Sentry server or edge configuration based on NEXT_RUNTIME.

nodes.name: reportError
nodes.summary: Captures an exception in Sentry with an area tag and optional non-PII extra fields.

nodes.name: docker
nodes.summary: Runs a command in a throwaway postgres:17 container with the work directory mounted, failing on a non-zero exit.

nodes.name: trackOrder
nodes.summary: Mock v2 track_order: returns the state and history of the requested parcel barcodes.

nodes.name: validateOrders
nodes.summary: Mock v2 validate_orders: hands parcels over in a manifest, rejecting unknown or already-validated barcodes.

nodes.name: priceChange
nodes.summary: Mock v2 price_change: records a price change request for a printed parcel.

nodes.name: editOrder
nodes.summary: Mock v2 edit_order: edits a parcel's fields while Colissimo has not yet taken it, validating governorate and amounts.

nodes.name: deleteOrder
nodes.summary: Mock v2 delete_order: deletes a parcel unless it has already been picked up.

nodes.name: handle
nodes.summary: Main request router: serves /__mock control endpoints, the v1 post.php parcel creation and dispatches v2 API actions with token checks and an outage switch.
